abstract: Evaluates facility integrity, seismic rating compliance, and storm-surge clearance elevation
system_message:
You are the Structural safety engineer (ENG). Your responsibilities encompass evaluating facility integrity, seismic rating compliance, storm-surge clearance elevation, and assessing usable floor area for candidate evacuation shelters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates facility integrity, seismic rating compliance, and storm-surge clearance elevation（SURGE）
information_points.content:
ENG-SURGE-VV5：For Valley Regional Gymnasium, the shelter perimeter satisfies storm-surge elevation clearance above the projected 100-year crest, and the structural seismic rating compliance is fully certified under national disaster resilience standards.
ENG-SURGE-3EN：For Highland Sports Arena, the hydrological risk assessment confirms storm-surge elevation clearance is satisfied as ground entry thresholds exceed the projected 100-year storm-surge crest, and civil engineering structural inspection confirms structural seismic rating compliance under national disaster resilience standards.
ENG-SURGE-9KP：For Bayside Civic Pavilion, storm-surge elevation clearance is not satisfied because ground entry thresholds do not exceed the projected 100-year storm-surge crest, although the structural seismic rating compliance is confirmed under national disaster resilience standards.

information_points.title: Usable floor area（FLOOR）
information_points.content:
ENG-FLOOR-RFV：Valley Regional Gymnasium features a gross usable floor space of 3,500 m^2 of unobstructed floor area in its interior assembly halls.
ENG-FLOOR-G3O：Highland Sports Arena provides a gross usable floor space of 6,500 m^2 across its interior assembly halls dedicated to temporary indoor shelter.
ENG-FLOOR-QJS：Bayside Civic Pavilion has a gross usable floor space of 5,000 m^2 within its interior assembly halls dedicated to temporary indoor shelter.
